title: World Bank jobs council urges 'crisis-era' employment support measures as IMF warns of AI ‘tsunami’
summary_full: IMF Chief Kristalina Georgieva warned AI is hitting the global labor market like a “slow-moving tsunami,” with young workers entering the job market the most exposed.
summary_public: IMF Chief Kristalina Georgieva warned AI is hitting the global labor market like a “slow-moving tsunami,” with young workers entering the job market the most exposed.
